detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🗑️ Welcome to the Junkyard — Bring a Friend

Somewhere under this mountain of trash is a cards worth a fortune. Dig for it solo, or in online co-op with a friend.

🃏 Dig, Sort, Collect

Every pile of junk is a gamble. Most of it is scrap — but sometimes the filth coughs up a rare card. Just one more pile.

💰 Trash to Treasure

Sell your junk for in-game cash, upgrade your tools, and expand your search. The deeper you dig, the better the finds.

Features

  • First-person junkyard digging - solo or online co-op

  • Collect fictional cards and build your collection

  • Sell junk for profit and upgrade your tools

  • Relaxing, cozy vibes with a sense of humor
